claim: Native restic 0.19.1 backed up two synthetic SQLite WAL journals copied by the stdlib Online Backup API during committed writes, read subset 1/1 (2/2 packs), restored 802816 identical journal bytes with matching external inventory and required state, and refused both snapshot and restore controls. Dagu 2.16.6 validated the scheduled research DAG offline; operating-host and off-host gates remain open.
limitations: Scratch local integration with synthetic research journals; not an unchanged upstream test suite or a real market/broker journal.
Per-journal Online Backup is independently consistent; no atomic cross-journal transaction or research consumer application restart was accepted.
One-part check 1/1 read 2/2 packs; default seven-part daily rotation is covered separately by stdlib tests and requires operator execution every 24 hours.
Operating host and independent alert path are user decision 2. No systemd unit was installed, enabled or started; no process-restart drill or scheduler was run.
A process-restart drill is not reboot, missed-run or independent-alert acceptance. permissions.run_dags scheduler behavior is source-reviewed and awaits the later host drill.
Off-host recovery stays open until user decision 3 chooses an independent destination and key recovery and a consumer restores on a second host against the independent inventory and required state.
Recovery-time objective, independent alerting and retention deletion remain unaccepted. No broker, credentials, live mode, model calls, commit or push was used.

The calendar lock lives in the nested PR-1 runtime bundle at the reviewed revision; this base has no runtime-2604/pyproject.toml. No trading runtime installation or calendar native execution is claimed.
